earnings.title: AbbVie Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Reports Third-Quarter Diluted EPS of $2.37 on a GAAP Basis, an Increase of Over 100.0 Percent; Adjusted Diluted EPS of $3.82, an Increase of Over 100.0 Percent; These Results Include an Unfavorable Impact of $0.11 Per Share Related to Acquired IPR&D and Milestones Expense
Delivers Third-Quarter Net Revenues of $17.404 Billion, an Increase of 10.3 Percent on a Reported Basis or 10.5 Percent on an Operational Basis

Third-Quarter Global Net Revenues from the Aesthetics Portfolio Were $1.176 Billion, a Decrease of 1.4 Percent on a Reported Basis, or 1.8 Percent on an Operational Basis; Global Botox Cosmetic Net Revenues Were $669 Million; Global Juvederm Net Revenues Were $222 Million
Announces 2027 Dividend Increase of 5.2 Percent, Beginning with Dividend Payable in February 2027
Worldwide net revenues were $17.404 billion, an increase of 10.3 percent on a reported basis, or 10.5 percent on an operational basis.

quotes.text: AbbVie continues to deliver outstanding results, reflecting solid execution across our diverse portfolio.

outlook: Raises 2026 Adjusted Diluted EPS Guidance Range from $13.76 - $13.96 to $13.95 - $13.99, which Includes an Unfavorable Impact of $0.69 Per Share Related to Acquired IPR&D and Milestones Expense Incurred Year-To-Date Through the Third Quarter 2026

AbbVie is raising its adjusted diluted EPS guidance for the full year 2026 from $13.76 - $13.96 to $13.95 - $13.99, which includes an unfavorable impact of $0.69 per share related to acquired IPR&D and milestones expense incurred year-to-date through the third quarter 2026.

items.heading: If any of the following risks and uncertainties develops into actual events, these events could have a material adverse effect on AbbVie's business, results of operations, financial condition or cash flows. In such case, the trading price of AbbVie's common stock could decline.

The expiration or loss of patent protection and licenses, including the loss of exclusivity for any of our products and increased competition from generics and biosimilars, may adversely affect AbbVie's revenues and operating earnings.
AbbVie's major products could lose patent protection earlier than expected, which could adversely affect AbbVie's revenues and operating earnings.
A third party's intellectual property may prevent AbbVie from selling its products or have a material adverse effect on AbbVie's profitability and financial condition.
AbbVie's research and development efforts may not succeed in developing products and technologies that can be successfully commercialized, which may cause its revenues and profitability to decline.

AbbVie is subject to cost-containment efforts and pricing pressures that could cause a reduction in revenues and operating earnings, and changes in the terms of rebate and chargeback programs, which are common in the pharmaceuticals industry, could have a material adverse effect on AbbVie's operations.
